title: Settle path depends on an undocumented Stripe Dashboard subscription: checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded
evidence: deployment/README.md:152-159: "## Stripe Dashboard checklist (out-of-band, manual)" / "- **Branding → Public details → Privacy policy URL** must equal `https://righttenantry.ie/privacy`. / - **Webhooks → Endpoint** points at the Cloud Run service URL with `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` matching the Dashboard signing secret. / - **API → Keys** match the `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` env var (test key in staging, live key in production)." — no event-subscription entry. webhook_handler.gleam:311: "| \"checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded\" ->" (new arm added by this PR; diff stat shows deployment/README.md untouched).
detail: The pending path settles only if the Dashboard endpoint subscribes the new event. Pre-deploy in-flight async sessions otherwise stay pending forever — landlord charged, vacancy never unlocks. Repo precedent documents such deps here (consent Terms URL entry); this one was not added.
recommended_fix: Add a Dashboard-checklist line: subscribe checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded (and async_payment_failed if resolving the pending state is desired) on the test+live endpoints, alongside the existing entries.

title: checkout.session.async_payment_failed is silently ignored — failed delayed payment leaves row permanently 'pending' with no terminal transition
evidence: webhook_handler.gleam:326-330: "// Unknown event type — ack without claiming. We only consume / // a row in `processed_stripe_event` for events we actually / // handle, so a future arm can be added without retroactively / // marking historical events as processed. / _ -> wisp.json_response(\"{}\", 200)" — async_payment_failed is not routed; the PendingPayment arm (line 445-453) logs "will settle via checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded" as the only resolution.
detail: A delayed-payment method that fails after completed(processing) has no handler: no claim, no state transition, no audit, no ops signal. checkout.session.expired cannot fire for an already-completed session, so the row is stuck in 'pending' forever. Fail-closed (no wrongful unlock), card-only prevents recurrence, but the sanctioned pending state machine lacks a failure terminal.
recommended_fix: Route checkout.session.async_payment_failed to mark the payment row 'failed' + audit (mirroring handle_checkout_failed), or document the accepted manual-ops resolution for stuck pending rows.
